title: Beef and sweet potato chilli
summary: Beef and sweet potato chilli is a mexican dinner built around lean beef mince 5% fat and sweet potatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Beef and sweet potato chilli. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add lean beef mince 5% fat and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and sweet potatoes.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until canned red kidney beans is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Beef and sweet potato chilli before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Beef and sweet potato chilli.  Check that the sweet potato is tender, then serve.
